$comment: Reject vectors that CANNOT express their declared fault in one mutation of their declared parent, with the reason for each. Written by hand and checked by scripts/accept-anchor-gate.py, which refuses three ways: an undeclared vector whose distance is not one, a declared vector whose distance has drifted from the count recorded here, and a declared vector that now measures one -- because a row that has stopped being an exception is a claim nobody re-read. The reason column is not decoration: a row with an empty reason is refused, since an allowlist that records which vectors were excused and not why is the same defect one level up from the one this check exists to close.

v59e16f48a28bec9d.reason: a record is appended and the row that used to resolve the interception is re-pointed at it. Appending alone leaves the row covered and asserts nothing; re-pointing alone has nothing to point at

vf362be6b8302b409.reason: as bad-104, on the reconstructed row: a valid interception is appended and the row is re-pointed at it, and neither half is a vector on its own

v02fe83a8a13cd303.reason: removing observationRecords removes the batch root's subject with it. A statement that carries a root over no records is a different fault, already covered by bad-408

v7622b2c58c2e272d.reason: the declared fault is a pair: one duplicate record and one undecodable record, appended together, to pin which of the two a rail reports first. The batch root goes with them, because a root over a record nobody can decode cannot be recomputed and so is compared as written rather than absorbed

va54b6faefcfb1f9e.reason: emptying the vocabulary's labels array must empty its caught array too. A caught set naming a label the vocabulary no longer lists is a different and earlier fault

v886b2a92cf14bd54.reason: the subject digest is not removed but replaced: the member moves from sha256 to sha512 and carries a sha512 value, because a subject with an empty digest object is a different fault

The extra record is a deliberate part of the construction and no differently-built vector avoids it

v3418101227718535.reason: a manifest that declares no class can be named by no row, so the row and the assessed class go with it. Leaving either behind names an attack the corpus does not declare, which is bad-806's fault and not this one

v22f545b6ff400646.reason: a class that declares no attack can be named by no row, so the row goes with the attack id. Leaving the row behind is bad-806's fault and not this one

v7f35f318b31ca92a.reason: the declared mutation IS a second run-level record: an arming record pinning a posture the run never pinned, plus the row reference that makes it covering

vc66a19c407888f78.reason: a deletion attack rebuilt end to end: an interception is dropped, the row that resolved it goes, the corpus manifest narrows to the attacks that remain, and the seal is left committing to the record that is gone. Every part is required for the statement to be self-consistent everywhere except at the commitment under test

vc2432d962eedc6a8.reason: a record is appended and the row is extended to resolve it, so the seal's commitment is short by exactly the record that was added rather than by a record nobody accounts for

vde0891384c1018ae.reason: the seal is re-signed naming two attacks, one row is removed, the interception it resolved is removed with it, and the corpus manifest is widened to declare the attack the seal now names. A seal naming an attack no row covers requires all four to be true at once

vacd28b5127a54254.reason: the row's attribution is raised to pinned AND the corpus gains the expectation that a pinned row is judged against. A pinned row with no corpus expectation is bad-959's fault

v37b29638601ce5ba.reason: an examination record is replaced by an interception: the kind, the method, the note and the commitment a record of that kind carries all move together, because an interception with no commitment is a different fault

v0639562eb10e87fb.reason: the covering record is replaced by one of a registered non-covering kind. The kind, the note and the commitment move together because a record of the new kind carries different members

vece82b6a9a07327a.reason: as bad-980, with a record kind that carries no payload commitment at all

v6ed1e2626b2af5ad.reason: the two pinned rows exchange their references. A permutation across two rows is one act and two edits, and permuting one row is the identity

v21e964dddeba0d08.reason: the middle channel's interception is deleted, and the two rows whose indices the deletion moves are re-pointed. Leaving either row alone would make it resolve a record belonging to another channel

v8a7532ae4cffa163.reason: as bad-722, and for the same reason: a run-chain declaration is not one member. aeeChainScope and aeeRunSeq only exist together, so a scope carrying a second unregistered token cannot be added to a parent that declares no sequence at all

vc19ea5aaacc5b72a.reason: two indexes are the fewest that can put an out-of-range reference BEHIND an in-range one, and the parent's artifact row carries an empty observationRefs array. bad-724 is the one-index form and both readings of the scan find it; the second index is what this vector is

v3759daaee191d532.reason: bad-851-predicate-empty-object. The three empty predicate states are one input and the vector's whole subject is which of the three spellings the producer chose, so the mutation is `predicate` becoming the empty object. Measured against the parent's leaves that is the removal of all seven members at once, and it cannot be fewer: an empty object is empty. Its two siblings, the absent member and the null, remove the same seven and measure one because the member itself goes with them, which is the distance metric describing the spelling rather than the edit

v6945133925a03e15.reason: the twin of the shipped no-vocabulary vector: the carried observationVocabulary is removed and the carried result is re-derived under the total recompute. Removing the vocabulary moves the value the recompute derives, so a statement that removed it and kept the parent's result would be refused for a stale result rather than exercise the empty-vocabulary reading; the re-derived result is what makes this the discriminating member of the pair

ve3c7f7a8d918c70c.reason: attackResults emptied, and the coverage map re-derived so it still accounts for every manifested attack: the one class the emptied row assessed leaves assessedClasses and enters outOfScope. Without the two coverage edits the statement is refused for coverage before the recompute is reached, and the shape this vector exists to put into the corpus -- zero rows, complete coverage, a declared result the recompute does not derive -- would never be judged
